traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are satisfied: - Traceability annotations work before, after, and interleaved with other JSDoc tags (dedicated valid tests). - Parser terminates annotation values at JSDoc tag boundaries and only continues multi-line values when the next line is not another @tag (processCommentLine + isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine + normalizeCommentLine). - JSDoc tag detection is generic (`@word`), excluding only @story/@req/@supports, fulfilling REQ-JSDOC-BOUNDARY-DETECTION. - No false positives are produced in the previously problematic scenario (`@req` followed by `@param`), covered by an explicit test. - Documentation has a clear "JSDoc coexistence" section with examples referencing this story. - Full Jest suite passes, including all earlier stories, demonstrating backward compatibility and correct error messaging.
Given the concrete implementation, targeted tests, updated documentation, and passing test run, the story is fully implemented.
